reference_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_products,
       COUNT(unit_cost_eur) AS n_with_cost,
       COUNT(sister_product_id) AS n_with_sister
FROM products
WHERE launch_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
